campaign.method: Clicked ticket and station buttons for each solution. First batch completed rounds 1–6 before tool timeout; observed six earned badges. Rounds 7–12 each returned visible next button; completion dialog confirmed all twelve.
campaign.failure: Round 5 route A-E-D-E-A-E uses all tickets with stars missing. Hint reports no solution; undo restores inverse ticket.
campaign.resourceTradeoff: 26 tests include independent BFS and near-star greedy failure for rounds 5–12.

tutorial.evidence: Practice reached C with one star and zero campaign badges; later replay/skip preserved 12/12.
